Name: Questie
Author: Kkthnx
Description:
[size=4][b]Questie[/b][/size]
A quest helper for Stardew Valley. It marks the people and monsters your quests need, marks the items in your backpack that a quest or a special order wants, and adds help to the end of each quest in your journal. That is how many you carry, where to fish, where to buy, how to make an item and who you still have to meet. It uses the game's own pictures and words, so it looks like part of the game.


[size=3][b]Screenshots[/b][/size]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kkthnx-Stardew/Questie/main/docs/images/markers.png[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kkthnx-Stardew/Questie/main/docs/images/log-fishing.png[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kkthnx-Stardew/Questie/main/docs/images/log-portraits.png[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kkthnx-Stardew/Questie/main/docs/images/log-chests.png[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kkthnx-Stardew/Questie/main/docs/images/item-marks.png[/img]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kkthnx-Stardew/Questie/main/docs/images/donation-box.png[/img]

This is a beta. It works and has been tested in the game, with about seventy other mods loaded, but it has had few players, so please report anything odd. Version 1.0 is kept for the first full release.

[size=3][b]What it does[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Markers over heads[/b]. A bouncing marker drawn with the game's own emote bubbles. An exclamation mark for someone to hand something in to (for a delivery it shows while you carry enough, with the item beside it), a speech bubble for a villager a meeting quest still needs, and a skull for a monster a kill quest asks for.[/*]
[*][b]Notes in the journal[/b]. Lines added to the end of a quest, so nothing the game says is replaced. The villager's portrait or the item's own picture in front of each name, how many you carry (and how many lie in your chests and fridge), where a fish bites with seasons, times and weather, which shops sell an item and for how much, how to make an item with a count of each ingredient you carry, how to learn a recipe you do not know, who is left to meet and where a person is right now.[/*]
[*][b]Marks on items[/b]. An item a quest or a special order wants gets the game's quest exclamation mark in the corner of its slot, in your backpack, in chests and on the toolbar. Hover over it and the tooltip says which one wants it and what to do.[/*]
[*][b]Special orders[/b]. The journal page of an order that asks for items says how many you carry that fit and where to take them, the person for a delivery, the place of the donation box, or the shipping bin. Orders ask for items by tag, such as any vegetable, and Questie uses the game's own rule for which items fit.[/*]
[*][b]Donation boxes[/b]. A list beside the box of a special order shows what it asks for and how far you have come, with the items' pictures, and it stays clear of the box and your backpack.[/*]
[*][b]A warning on the last day[/b] of a timed quest such as a Help Wanted request.[/*]
[*][b]A meeting quest that can be finished[/b]. When a save loads, people who no longer exist are taken off Introductions and sociable villagers you have not met are added, by the game's own rule. Each change is logged.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Works with expansions[/b][/size]
Tried with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Sunberry Village and More New Fish among about seventy mods. Their villagers get markers, portraits and a place on a meeting quest, their fish show their places and seasons, their shops and recipes are named, and their donation orders get the list beside the box. Quests they add that are of the game's usual kinds work like any other.

[size=3][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]
Quests belong to each player, so markers and notes follow your own journal. It was tested with one host and one joining player on one computer. Three or more players, split screen and play over the internet are untested.

[size=3][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.2.1 or newer.[/*]
[*]Unzip the Questie folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[/list]Needs Stardew Valley 1.6.9 or newer. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional and gives you the settings in the game.

[size=3][b]Settings[/b][/size]
Everything is on by default. Each part has its own switch in config.json and in Generic Mod Config Menu. You can turn off the markers, the delivery, hand-in, meeting and monster markers one by one, the journal notes, the fishing, shop, recipe and person notes, the pictures beside names, the item marks, the donation list, the last day warning and the meeting quest repair.

[size=3][b]Limits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The notes are in English. The translation file is i18n/default.json, and other languages can be added the usual way.[/*]
[*]Special orders get item marks, hand-in and kill markers and journal notes for the objectives that ask you to deliver, donate, ship or kill. Objectives that count what you pick up, catch or reach are left to the game's own progress bars.[/*]
[*]Fish seasons come from the game's location list. A fish that a mod limits to a season in some other way may be listed for more seasons than it bites in.[/*]
[*]Quest kinds from other mods that are not one of the game's own are left alone.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Feedback, please[/b][/size]
Tell me what looks wrong or missing. For a bug, open a GitHub issue and paste the output of the [b]questie_report[/b] console command, which lists the quests Questie sees, the notes it adds and who and what it marks. For a crash, upload your SMAPI log at smapi.io/log and link it.
[list]
[*]Comment here, or open a [url=https://github.com/Kkthnx-Stardew/Questie/issues/new/choose]GitHub issue[/url].[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Source and credits[/b][/size]
The source is MIT licensed and lives at [url=https://github.com/Kkthnx-Stardew/Questie]github.com/Kkthnx-Stardew/Questie[/url]. Questie was written from scratch. This is a fan-made mod and is not affiliated with ConcernedApe.
